entries.title: Psalms 102:1
segments: A prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come to You.

entries.title: Psalms 102:2
segments: Hide not Your face from me in the day when I am in trouble; bow down Your ear to me; in the day I call, answer me quickly.

entries.title: Psalms 102:3
segments: For my days go up like smoke, and my bones glow like a firebrand.

entries.title: Psalms 102:4
segments: My heart is stricken, and dried like grass, so that I forget to eat my bread.

entries.title: Psalms 102:5
segments: Because of the voice of my groaning, my bones hold fast to my skin.

entries.title: Psalms 102:6
segments: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am like an owl of the desert.

entries.title: Psalms 102:7
segments: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone on the house top.

entries.title: Psalms 102:8
segments: My enemies curse me all the day; and they who are mad against me are sworn against me.

entries.title: Psalms 102:9
segments: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and have mixed my drink with weeping,

entries.title: Psalms 102:10
segments: because of Your anger and Your wrath; for You have lifted me up and cast me down.

entries.title: Psalms 102:11
segments: My days [are] like a shadow stretched out; and I wither like grass.

entries.title: Psalms 102:12
segments: But You, O LORD, shall endure forever; and Your memory to all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 102:13
segments: You shall arise, [and] have mercy on Zion; for the time to pity her, yea, the set time, has come.

entries.title: Psalms 102:14
segments: For Your servants take pleasure in its stones, and pity its dust.

entries.title: Psalms 102:15
segments: So the nations shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth Your glory.

entries.title: Psalms 102:16
segments: When the LORD shall build up Zion, He shall appear in His glory.

entries.title: Psalms 102:17
segments: He will turn to the prayer of the forsaken and not despise their prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 102:18
segments: This shall be written for the generation to come; and the people who shall be created shall praise the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 102:19
segments: For He has looked down from the height of His sanctuary; from Heaven the LORD beheld the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 102:20
segments: to hear the groaning of the prisoner, to set free the sons of death;

entries.title: Psalms 102:21
segments: to declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and His praise in Jerusalem;

entries.title: Psalms 102:22
segments: when the peoples and the kingdoms have gathered together to serve the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 102:23
segments: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

entries.title: Psalms 102:24
segments: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days; Your years [are] through the generation of generations.

entries.title: Psalms 102:25
segments: Of old You have laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens [are] the work of Your hands.

entries.title: Psalms 102:26
segments: They shall perish, but You shall endure; yea, all of them shall become old like a garment; like a robe You shall change them, and they shall be changed;

entries.title: Psalms 102:27
segments: but You [are] He, and Your years shall have no end.

entries.title: Psalms 102:28
segments: The sons of Your servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before You.
